name: moon
label: MOON
frame: Origin on the real floor under the seated eye; azimuth in degrees clockwise from the user's forward at recentre (+90 = right); elevation in degrees above the eye's horizontal. Metres.

sky.note: Brightness is baked (build_moon.py STAR_GAIN); intensity multiplies it.

ground.note: Inside the 200 m camera far plane. relief: [distance m, height scale m] pairs, linear between; rim_lift raises the far ring so the edge sits above eye level. Floor (height 0) inside flat_radius_m: no slope under the user.
